description: This Kotlin source file defines an object IconsUsageProbe that provides a method to retrieve resource IDs for icons used within the application. It exposes a function getIconIds that returns an array of drawable resource IDs, which are placeholders for various icons like 'like', 'love', 'dislike', and 'close'. The class serves as an interface for discovering icon resource IDs mapped via theme aliases.

classes.name: IconsUsageProbe
classes.description: An object that provides access to icon resource IDs to ensure resources are discoverable and mapped via theme aliases.

methods.name: getIconIds
methods.description: Returns an array of drawable resource IDs for icons used in the app, such as like, love, dislike, and close.
